description: Authorizes employee expense reimbursement after validating employee identity, receipt attachment, expense category approval, and amount limits. Worked example for LIVE-API-GUIDE.md's "How to Write a New Policy" section.

unboundSignalReasons.employeeVerified: Independently attested by an HR/identity system; no Intent-side equivalent field exists to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.receiptAttached: Result of a document-upload check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.categoryApproved: Result of an expense-category policy lookup, evaluated independently of this Intent.

outcome.reason: Expense authorized: employee verified, receipt attached, category approved, amount within limit.
Expense rejected: amount exceeds the $5,000 auto-approval limit.
Expense rejected: one or more required conditions were not satisfied.
